description: Google Docs API - Create, edit, format documents, manage content, collaborate

tools.name: google_docs_smart_create_from_markdown
tools.description: 🤖 SMART TOOL: Create a fully formatted Google Doc from markdown in ONE CALL. Supports ALL formatting: headings (# to ######), colored headings (## Title {#1a73e8}), **bold**, *italic*, ~~strikethrough==, ==highlight==, `inline code`, ```code blocks```, [links](url), ![images](url), - nested bullets (2 spaces = 1 level), 1. nested numbers, > blockquotes, --- horizontal lines, <<NEW-PAGE>>, and | tables | with | content |

markdown_content.description: Full markdown content with ALL features: # headings (H1-H6), colored headings (## Title {#hexcode}), **bold**, *italic*, ~~strikethrough~~, ==highlight==, `code`, ```blocks```, [text](url) links, ![alt](url) images, nested lists (indent with 2 spaces), > blockquotes, --- lines, <<NEW-PAGE>>, | tables |

returns.description: Created document with ID, shareable URL, and formatting stats

tools.name: google_docs_smart_update
tools.description: 🚀 SMART UPDATE TOOL: Add formatted markdown to EXISTING Google Docs using mathematical index tracking. Only 2 API calls (vs 20+)! Works on documents with existing content. Supports all formatting: # headings, colored headings (## Title {#1a73e8}), **bold**, *italic*, ~~strikethrough~~, ==highlight==, `code`, [links](url), - lists, | tables |. Returns end_index for chaining updates.

document_id.description: ID of EXISTING Google Doc to update

markdown_content.description: Markdown content to insert (same features as smart_create_from_markdown)

insertion_position.description: Where to insert: 'end' (append - default), 'start' (beginning), or specific index number

returns.description: Result with start_index, end_index (for chaining!), operations count, and URL

tools.name: google_docs_create_professional_report_with_charts
tools.description: Create a professional stakeholder-ready Google Doc report with linked Google Sheets charts. Creates CLEAN document (no instructions) with chart placeholders and a separate spreadsheet with interactive charts. Charts have black centered titles, axis labels with units, legends. Document uses Figure 1, Figure 2 format with hyperlinks to exact chart locations. Perfect for financial reports, business analytics, presentations.

report_title.description: Title for both document and spreadsheet (e.g., 'Q1 2025 Financial Report')

charts_config.description: Array of chart configurations. Each chart needs: title (str), headers (array of column names), data (2D array), chart_type (COLUMN/BAR/LINE/AREA/PIE), x_axis (label), y_axis (label with units like 'Amount ($)'). Example: [{title: 'Monthly Revenue', headers: ['Month','Revenue ($)'], data: [['Jan',125000],['Feb',138000]], chart_type: 'COLUMN', x_axis: 'Month', y_axis: 'Amount ($)'}]

separate_sheets.description: True = each chart in own sheet tab (recommended), False = all charts in one sheet

returns.description: Contains document_id, document_url, spreadsheet_id, spreadsheet_url, charts array (with title/chart_id/data_range/sheet_name/link for each), and instructions string with step-by-step guide for inserting charts

tools.name: google_sheets_create
tools.description: Create a new Google Sheets spreadsheet with optional data and headers. Uses official Google Sheets API (no gspread required). Can create empty spreadsheets or populate with data immediately. Auto-formats header row with bold text and gray background.

data.description: Optional 2D array of data rows. Example: [['Alice', 100], ['Bob', 200]]

returns.description: Contains spreadsheet_id, spreadsheet_url, and success status

tools.name: google_sheets_read_data
tools.description: Read data from a Google Sheets spreadsheet using official Google Sheets API

range.description: Range in A1 notation (e.g., 'Sheet1!A1:D10' or just 'A1:D10')

returns.description: Contains values (2D array), range, and row/column counts

tools.name: google_sheets_append_data
tools.description: Append data to a Google Sheets spreadsheet (adds rows at the end)

values.description: 2D array of values to append. Example: [['Alice', 100], ['Bob', 200]]

returns.description: Contains updated spreadsheet info and number of rows appended

tools.name: google_docs_add_formatted_content
tools.description: Add sample formatted content to a Google Doc to demonstrate rich text capabilities. Adds: Heading 1, Heading 2, paragraphs with bold/italic text, bulleted lists, numbered lists, and mixed formatting. Useful for testing or creating template documents.

tools.name: google_charts_create
tools.description: Create a professional Google Chart in a new Google Sheets spreadsheet. Supports 10+ chart types (column, bar, line, area, pie, scatter, combo, histogram, candlestick, bubble) with customization options (title, axis labels, colors, legend, dimensions). Returns spreadsheet with embedded interactive chart.

data.description: 2D array of data. First column = labels/x-axis, remaining = data series. Example: [['Jan', 10, 20], ['Feb', 15, 25]]

chart_options.description: Optional customization: {title: str, subtitle: str, x_axis_title: str, y_axis_title: str, width: int, height: int, legend_position: str, colors: [str], stacked: bool}

returns.description: Contains spreadsheet_id, spreadsheet_url, chart_id, and chart details

tools.name: google_docs_insert_chart
tools.description: Create a Google Chart and insert it as an image into a Google Doc. Creates temporary spreadsheet with chart, exports as PNG, inserts into doc, and cleans up. Supports all chart types from google_charts_create.

insertion_index.description: Position in doc to insert chart (null = end of document)

returns.description: Contains inserted status, image_url, temp_spreadsheet_id, chart_type, insertion_index

tools.name: google_docs_ai_smart_generate_document
tools.description: 🤖 SMART TOOL: AI-powered document generation from natural language in ONE call. Takes a prompt like 'Create a product requirements document for a mobile app' and AI generates complete, professionally formatted document with proper structure, headings, lists, tables. Use this instead of manually writing documents.

prompt.description: Natural language description of document to create. Examples: 'Create a product requirements document for a mobile fitness app with sections for overview, features, technical specs, timeline', 'Write a professional project proposal for website redesign', 'Generate meeting minutes template'

share_with.description: Email addresses to share document with

folder_id.description: Google Drive folder ID to store document in

include_toc.description: Add table of contents at beginning

tools.efficiency: 99% faster than manual writing (2 hours → 10 seconds)

tools.name: google_docs_smart_bulk_create_multiple
tools.description: 📚 SMART TOOL: Bulk create multiple Google Docs in ONE call. Creates multiple complete documents simultaneously from markdown or AI generation. Each document can have different content, sharing, and folder settings. Perfect for batch operations.

documents.description: Array of document configurations. Each can be: {'title': str, 'markdown_content': str} OR {'title': str, 'prompt': str, 'tone': str}. Example: [{'title': 'Q1 Report', 'markdown_content': '# Q1...'}, {'title': 'Q2 Report', 'prompt': 'Create Q2 financial report'}]

share_with.description: Default email addresses to share ALL documents with (can be overridden per document)

folder_id.description: Default Google Drive folder for ALL documents (can be overridden per document)

use_cases: Create 12 monthly report documents at once
Generate meeting notes for entire quarter
Create product documentation for multiple features
Bulk create project proposals for clients
Generate onboarding docs for new employees
tools.efficiency: 97% reduction in tool calls (20 calls per doc × 5 docs = 100 calls → 1 call)
